name: Dr. Dharmasthala Veerendra Heggade
profession: Heggade/Pattadhikari, Chief Functionary of Shri Manjunatheshwara Temple, Dharmasthala
present_address: Tower A-2, B-19 Deen Dayal Upadhyay Marg, New Delhi 110002
permanent_address: Dharmadhikari, Sri Manjunatha Swamy Temple, Beedu, Dharmasthala, Belthangady Thaluk, Dakshin Kannada District Karnataka - 574216
social_activities: Established Shri Kshethra Dharmasthala Rural Development Project Trust, a leading NGO undertaking SHG movement by managing 6,25,000 groups and consisting 52 lakhs members; contributed to the revival of Yakshagana; maintaining a pure traditional approach supported preserving Tuluva culture and heritage; established SDM Education Society which is running 52 premier academic and professional institutions across Karnataka ; 5,000 palm-leaf manuscripts are preserved scientifically through ‘Sri Manjunatheshwara Samskrithi Samshodhana Prathistana’; established Rural Development and Self Employment Training Institutes (RUDSETI) in 1982 which in turn replicated through 590 Rural Self Employment Training Institute (RSETIs) across the Nation to train rural youth for self-employment; more than 40 lakh youths have been trained who have established their own start-ups
hobbies: Shuttle badminton, photography; collection of antiques and valuable artefacts through Manjusha Museum one of the finest Museum in the country; collection of vintage cars
countries_visited: Turkey, Russia, Burma, China, Malaysia, U.S.A., U.A.E., Australia, Japan and U.K.
other_information: Has dexterously blended spiritualism with the materialistic world; a multifaceted personality engaged in the service to God as Dharmadhikari; as a Chief functionary of Shri Manjunatha Swamy Temple, has implemented several unique programmes for the spiritual upliftment; has also promoted many institutions, trusts, societies, etc. to generously promote historical traditional chaturdana tradition of Sri Kshethra Dharmasthala for the purpose of comprehensive socio-economic development of the people and the society; awarded, (i) Rajyothsava Award, 1985 by Government of Karnataka, (ii) Karnataka Rathna, 2009 for social work, (iii) Rajarshi citation by the then President of India, Dr. Shankar Dayal Sharma and (iv) Padma Vibhushan, 2015 for social work; recipient of Honorary Doctorates from Mangalore University, 1994, Karnataka University, 2010 and Drew University, U.S.A., 2010.
